directions: In this task, you are to write an essay on the necessity of developing social skills for college students. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Developing social skills is of great necessity for college students. To begin with, these skills are crucial for building relationships. In college, students interact with peers, professors, and various people on campus. For example, good communication skills can help students make friends easily and get along well with roommates, which enriches their campus life.

In addition, social skills are beneficial for future career development. Many jobs require teamwork and communication. Students with well-developed social skills can express their ideas clearly in meetings and collaborate effectively with colleagues. For instance, a student who can network well may have more job opportunities.

Furthermore, social skills contribute to personal growth. They can boost students' self-confidence. When students can handle social situations smoothly, they feel a sense of accomplishment. 

In conclusion, college students should attach great importance to developing social skills as they are essential for their relationships, career, and personal growth.
